meta.title: Business Analyst
meta.tagline: Bridge business needs with technical solutions through data-driven insights.
meta.description: Business analysts analyze business processes, identify requirements and design solutions that improve efficiency. They translate between business stakeholders and technical teams using data analysis, process modeling and requirements documentation.

details.description: Business analysts analyze business processes, identify requirements and design solutions that improve efficiency. They translate between business stakeholders and technical teams using data analysis, process modeling and requirements documentation.
